subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a separate `dmThreadMode` account option, folded into the existing `replyToMode` contract, or deferred because Google Chat DMs should stay flat by default?
rationale: This is a new user-facing config/product surface that reopens a previously fixed invalid-thread delivery path, and repository policy requires maintainer intent for config/default and channel-delivery compatibility choices.

options.title: Choose API before merge
options.body: Recommended: pause merge until maintainers decide the permanent Google Chat DM threading API, then require the selected contract plus live proof.

options.title: Accept separate dmThreadMode
options.body: Allow this feature as a separate opt-in key, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs, and real Google Chat default/opt-in proof before merge.

options.title: Defer DM threading
options.body: Keep Google Chat DMs flat and ask for a new narrower proposal if live API behavior or user need proves that DM thread targets are supported and wanted.

recommendation.title: Choose API before merge
recommendation.body: Recommended: pause merge until maintainers decide the permanent Google Chat DM threading API, then require the selected contract plus live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and verified the prior DM thread-suppression fix and has recent history on the Google Chat threading path.
